concepts.def: 230 V AC at 50 Hz; standard for household appliances.
Stores chemical energy released as electricity; primary (single-use) or secondary (rechargeable).
Converts sunlight directly to electricity; used in solar panels.
Turbines convert wind kinetic energy to electricity; offshore arrays common in UK.
EU/UK label (A to G) classifying appliance energy use; affects purchasing decisions.
Unit of power equal to one joule per second; rated on lamps, motors, kettles.
